label: v4.0.0.16 claims every index-reading git call in the commit and push hooks is bounded at 20s with BLOCKED [gate:git-timeout], but the trigger-phrase gate introduced in v4.0.0.5 runs its own git diff --cached through execFileSync with no timeout and without core.fsmonitor=false, as a child process that cannot write the bound record, so a wedged index lock or fsmonitor daemon still hangs that commit with no bound and no refusal message

pre-commit branches on any non-zero exit from template-phrase-lint and always prints BLOCKED [gate:template-phrase-lint]: staged trigger phrases contain a template or editor fallback; the linter's distinct exit 2 fingerprint path is never read, so a crash or an unguarded git ENOENT is reported to the operator as a phrase violation, and the v4.0.0.5 promise that a missing git warns and lets the commit through has no guard on either side of the process boundary
verify: run the linter under a PATH without git and compare the exit code with 2

label: The v4.0.0.15 ambiguity claims are implemented exactly as described: clustersWithTop returns false for a member whose heldBelow names the top and for a floor-only member when the top earned its own confidence, on a single 0.05 margin; live, the phrase the v4.0.0.16 note says now routes to sk-doc returns sk-doc first at 0.3465/0.82 with compiledRoute packet sk-create-changelog and no ambiguity flag
verify: node .skilled/bin/skill-advisor.cjs advisor_recommend --json '{"prompt":"write a changelog for this packet"}' --format json

label: bounded-git carries one bound under two env names (GIT_BOUND_SECONDS and SPECKIT_GIT_TIMEOUT) while only the second reaches the operator message, runs unbounded when perl is absent with the notice confined to a source comment, and pre-commit substitutes an unbounded git_bounded with a WARNING [gate:git-timeout] when the helper file is unreadable, so an operator grepping for the documented BLOCKED [gate:git-timeout] sees nothing while the gate is unarmed; collapsing the alias and raising the fail-open notice to the block's severity costs nothing

The generation-1 sk-create-skill-parent question is narrowed, not closed: /create:skill-parent for a new hub skill routes to sk-doc at 0.3765/0.82 with compiledRoute packet sk-create-skill and heldBelow null, which is consistent with entering the parent packet a skill-parent request should enter, but sk-create-skill's ROUTER forwarding to sk-create-skill-parent was not read and the duplicate package_skill.py half is untouched
verify: read sk-create-skill ROUTER for the skill-parent lead phrase

label: A hook gate that can block must distinguish a policy violation from a tool crash; a single non-zero exit conflates them and makes every failure message untrustworthy
A wall-clock bound advertised as universal must cover every process the gate spawns, including child processes the shell hook cannot instrument

The sk-doc ranked first on 0.346 while the next candidates carry higher association numbers; recorded again as an observation, not a finding, because the dominant lane is documented and output order alone cannot establish a sort fault

core.hooksPath on this host is a global symlink farm into .skilled/scripts/git-hooks, so the hooks under audit are the ones actually installed, and the phrase gate is additionally scoped by _in_toolchain_repo

direction: v4.0.0.5 fail-open for a missing YAML library is broken
reason: The linter loads its frontmatter parser through a dynamic import inside a try block, so a missing js-yaml is caught rather than exiting non-zero; only the git-unavailable leg remains unguarded
